star.situation: Pengelolaan administrasi SPP, tagihan siswa, dan pembukuan kas madrasah masih manual serta belum terintegrasi langsung dengan perbankan syariah mitra, memicu antrean fisik dan potensi selisih rekapitulasi kas.
star.task: Merancang dan membangun sistem informasi ERP keuangan madrasah secara end-to-end dengan gateway pembayaran bank otomatis, pembukuan kas instan, dan otorisasi multi-role.
star.action: Mengembangkan integrasi Host-to-Host (H2H) Virtual Account dengan bank-grade webhook security (IP whitelisting & anti-replay protection), pemantauan status lunas real-time via Server-Sent Events (SSE), modul auto-journaling akuntansi Buku Kas Umum (BKU), serta pipeline CI/CD GitHub Actions dan automated database backup ke bot Telegram.
star.result: Digitalisasi pembayaran SPP 100% otomatis, eliminasi risiko rekonsiliasi manual berkat reverse-inquiry scheduler, dan ketersediaan laporan BKU audit-ready ekspor PDF/Excel secara instan.

en.title: SIM Keuangan MAN — School Financial ERP & Banking H2H Integration
en.situation: School tuition billing, student invoicing, and cash administration were managed manually without institutional banking integration, causing physical queues and manual book-balancing discrepancies.
en.task: Engineered an end-to-end school financial ERP and billing management system with automated banking gateway integrations and multi-role access control.
en.action: Developed Host-to-Host (H2H) Virtual Account integration with partner Bank featuring bank-level webhook security (IP whitelisting & anti-replay protection), real-time payment updates via Server-Sent Events (SSE), automated double-entry General Cash Book (BKU) journaling, and automated CI/CD deployment pipelines with Telegram database backup alerts.
en.result: Automated tuition billing and reconciliation workflows end-to-end, eliminated manual cash reconciliation risks, and produced official audit-ready BKU reports exportable to PDF/Excel.

projects.description: Sistem Informasi Manajemen Keuangan Madrasah Aliyah Negeri (MAN) dengan integrasi langsung Host-to-Host (H2H) dengan Bank Mitra. Menyediakan Virtual Account otomatis dengan webhook perbankan terproteksi, pencatatan jurnal akuntansi otomatis (auto-journaling), rekonsiliasi rekening koran, dan penyusunan RKA bulanan.
projects.stats: H2H Virtual Account & Instant Settlement SSE

projects.title: Acrylico ERP — Enterprise Resource Planning & Shop Floor Management

star.situation: Workshop manufaktur fabrikasi akrilik dan signage memerlukan digitalisasi presensi karyawan pabrik yang akurat serta pelacakan antrean order lantai produksi yang transparan secara real-time.
star.task: Memimpin rancang bangun sistem ERP manufaktur dan modul Shop Floor Tracking modular berbasis web dan mobile.
star.action: Membangun portal karyawan PWA offline-first dengan presensi GPS geofencing radius ketat dan verifikasi selfie biometrik, otomasi payroll berjenjang dengan potongan kasbon/lembur, sinkronisasi antrean kerja lantai produksi via WebSocket (Laravel Reverb), dan pengujian E2E otomatis berbasis Playwright.
star.result: Otomasi total rekap penggajian bebas salah hitung, eliminasi kecurangan absensi berkat geofencing & biometrik, serta visibilitas progres pengerjaan signage secara live antar-stasiun bengkel.

en.title: Acrylico ERP — Enterprise Resource Planning & Shop Floor Management
en.situation: An acrylic and signage manufacturing workshop needed automated shop-floor tracking and fraud-proof worker attendance directly connected with payroll calculations.
en.task: Led full-cycle design and development of an Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform and real-time shop floor production tracking system.
en.action: Built an offline-first mobile PWA for employee attendance with high-precision GPS geofencing and selfie photo verification, automated multi-tier payroll with overtime and cash advance deductions, real-time shop floor order tracking via WebSockets (Laravel Reverb), and automated E2E tests with Playwright.
en.result: Fully automated payroll processing eliminating calculation errors, prevented attendance fraud with biometric/geofencing verification, and provided live production queue visibility across workshop stations.

projects.description: Sistem ERP modular dan Shop Floor Tracking khusus industri manufaktur fabrikasi akrilik dan signage. Dilengkapi portal karyawan PWA mobile (absensi GPS geofence, selfie biometrik, offline-first), otomasi penggajian & kasbon, serta sinkronisasi antrean produksi lantai kerja real-time via WebSocket.
projects.stats: PWA Offline-First & Live Shop Floor WebSocket

projects.title: Nastiti Utama Mandiri — Operations & Financial Management Platform

star.situation: Operasional proyek promosi dan penugasan tim lapangan (SPG/Field Officers) menghadapi kendala perhitungan margin laba proyek manual, dokumentasi foto lapangan tanpa verifikasi lokasi, dan alur penagihan klien yang lambat.
star.task: Membangun platform manajemen operasional dan finansial proyek terpadu mulai dari siklus order, form survei lapangan, hingga penerbitan Berita Acara (BAPP).
star.action: Merancang kalkulator penawaran Bill of Quantities (BQ) dinamis dengan estimasi net profit margin otomatis, formulir digital staf lapangan yang tersinkronisasi real-time ke Google Sheets via background job queue, laporan foto ber-watermark koordinat GPS & timestamp, modul invoicing termin, dan pembagian hak akses pengguna multi-divisi (RBAC).
star.result: Kepastian margin keuntungan proyek secara presisi sebelum eksekusi, pelaporan aktivitas lapangan transparan anti-titip foto, dan percepatan siklus penagihan pembayaran resmi ke klien.

en.title: Nastiti Utama Mandiri — Operations & Financial Management Platform
en.situation: Field promotional operations and field officer deployments suffered from manual net-margin calculations, unverifiable paper reporting, and delayed client invoicing.
en.task: Engineered an operations and financial management platform covering the complete project lifecycle from order processing to formal handover certificates (BAPP).
en.action: Built a dynamic Bill of Quantities (BQ) pricing engine with automated net margin forecasting, digital field forms synchronizing in real time to Google Sheets via background queues, GPS/timestamp-watermarked photo reporting, client invoicing with tax numbers, and multi-division RBAC security.
en.result: Guaranteed project profitability margins prior to execution, ensured fraud-proof field accountability, and accelerated official client payment cycles.

projects.description: Platform manajemen proyek dan operasional terpadu yang mencakup pengelolaan siklus pesanan, penugasan tim lapangan, otomatisasi formulir digital tersinkronisasi real-time ke Google Sheets, kalkulasi biaya (BQ) dan estimasi margin laba bersih otomatis, penagihan klien (invoicing) dengan penerbitan Berita Acara (BAPP), serta proteksi hak akses pengguna multi-divisi.
projects.stats: Dynamic BQ & Realtime Project Net Margin

projects.title: Nata Code — Creative Agency & Interactive Platform

star.situation: Studio software house dan SaaS Nata Code membutuhkan platform digital resmi bertaraf internasional untuk showcase produk dan penawaran layanan software kelas enterprise.
star.task: Merancang dan membangun platform digital resmi dengan desain sistem modular, interaktivitas visual tingkat tinggi, dan navigasi aplikasi tanpa jeda.
star.action: Membangun arsitektur Single Page Application (SPA) berbasis Laravel dan React 18 / Inertia.js, mengimplementasikan visual 3D interaktif Three.js, smooth scrolling dinamis (Locomotive Scroll), mikro-interaksi mikro-animasi dengan GSAP dan Framer Motion, serta token arsitektur desain Tailwind CSS & Radix UI.
star.result: Tampilan platform agensi modern berkecepatan tinggi dengan navigasi SPA instan dan pengalaman visual interaktif 3D yang memikat calon klien enterprise.

en.title: Nata Code — Creative Agency & Interactive Platform
en.situation: Software house and SaaS studio Nata Code required an international-standard digital platform and modular design system to showcase enterprise software solutions.
en.task: Designed and developed the agency's official web presence and design system featuring high-end visual interactivity and zero-latency page navigation.
en.action: Architected a high-performance Single Page Application (SPA) with Laravel and React 18 / Inertia.js, integrated interactive 3D visual assets with Three.js, smooth scrolling via Locomotive Scroll, micro-interactions with GSAP and Framer Motion, and design tokens using Tailwind CSS and Radix UI.
en.result: Delivered an award-tier agency web experience with seamless SPA transitions, optimal load speeds, and compelling 3D interactivity for enterprise prospect conversion.

projects.description: Platform digital resmi studio software house & SaaS Nata Code berstandar agensi internasional. Menampilkan interaksi visual 3D interaktif berbasis Three.js, smooth scrolling dinamis (Locomotive Scroll), mikro-interaksi responsif dengan GSAP, dan arsitektur desain sistem modular.

experiences.description: Merancang dan membangun platform digital resmi serta arsitektur sistem desain untuk studio software house & SaaS: antarmuka web interaktif dengan smooth scrolling (Locomotive Scroll), visual 3D (Three.js), animasi responsif dengan GSAP dan Framer Motion, pustaka komponen reusable (React 18, Radix UI, Tailwind CSS), serta integrasi backend Laravel SPA via Inertia.js.

Memimpin rancang bangun sistem ERP Manufaktur dan Realtime Shop Floor Tracking khusus industri fabrikasi akrilik dan signage: portal karyawan PWA offline-first (absensi GPS geofencing & selfie biometrik), otomasi penggajian berjenjang, kasbon & slip gaji otomatis via WhatsApp/PDF, pemantauan lantai produksi real-time via WebSocket (Laravel Reverb), serta pengujian E2E otomatis Playwright.

Membangun alur bisnis inti dan operasional proyek secara end-to-end: pengelolaan siklus pesanan, penugasan tim lapangan (SPG/Field Officers) dengan laporan foto ber-watermark GPS & timestamp, formulir digital staf lapangan yang tersinkronisasi real-time ke Google Sheets via background queue, kalkulator BQ dinamis & margin laba bersih proyek, penagihan klien terpadu (faktur & BAPP), serta RBAC multi-divisi.

Merancang dan membangun sistem informasi manajemen keuangan dan billing sekolah end-to-end: integrasi Virtual Account Bank Mitra (Host-to-Host & webhook) dengan bank-grade security (IP whitelisting & anti-replay protection), pencatatan jurnal akuntansi otomatis (auto-journaling), persetujuan anggaran RKA bulanan, pelaporan Buku Kas Umum (BKU) ekspor PDF/Excel, otomasi impor data massal, serta pipeline CI/CD GitHub Actions dan backup database via Telegram bot.
